presentation.label: Vaginal bleeding
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us more about the bleeding, including when it started and any other symptoms you have noticed.

questions.question: Did the bleeding occur after sexual intercourse?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate bleeding after sexual intercourse?

questions.question: Has this bleeding happened more than once?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the bleeding has happened more than once?

questions.question: Have you had a smear test done in the last 6 months?
Have you noticed any vaginal discharge?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response mention any vaginal discharge?

questions.question: Do you have any pelvic pain?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response mention pelvic pain or lower abdominal pain?

questions.question: Have you started, stopped or changed any hormonal contraception in the last 6 months?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has started, stopped or changed any hormonal contraception in the last 6 months?

questions.question: Are your periods usually regular?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient usually has regular periods?

questions.question: How heavy was the bleeding? (e.g. spotting, like a period, or heavier - you may want to mention how many pads or tampons you needed)
